notes: UK depth batch 2 (MVNOs). Sources: official T&Cs (1pMobile July 2026 terms, LycaMobile FAQ) + Ken's Tech Tips PAYG inactivity comparison (Feb 2024, cites official clauses) + MSE forum + ISPreview. FX GBP->CNY 9.3.

routes.simType: physical + eSIM (eSIM availability per official site; verify at checkout)
routes.acquisitionSummary: Order SIM from 1pmobile.com (free SIM, requires UK delivery address). First top-up £10 activates. EE network, 1p/min, 1p/text, 1p/MB PAYG rates.

keep.action: Official T&Cs (updated 24 Jul 2026): minimum spend £10 per Commitment Period. Customers joining from 1 Aug 2026: every 90 days (£40/yr). Customers who joined earlier: every 60 days (£60/yr, per Oct 2024 ISPreview report). Shortfall auto-deducted from balance; balance hits zero + no top-up within 10 days = account closed, number lost.

routes.chinaActivation: SIM dispatched to UK addresses; activate on EE network. China-first activation unverified.
routes.payment: UK card for online top-up; international card acceptance unverified.
routes.wifiCalling: Supported (EE MVNO, per official feature list).

routes.acquisitionSummary: Free SIM from mobile.asda.com (UK delivery). PAYG rates 15p/min, 10p/text, 10p/MB on Vodafone network. 4G only unless spending >=£10/mo.

keep.action: Official FAQ: top-up OR bundle purchase every 180 days keeps credit and account active; each top-up resets the window. Min top-up £5 (per Ken's Tech Tips). After 180 days without top-up: restricted (can still receive calls/texts), must call 0808 006 2732 to reactivate.

routes.chinaActivation: UK network activation expected; China-first activation unverified.
routes.payment: UK card / ASDA top-up card; international card acceptance unverified.
routes.roamingSms: Receiving SMS abroad generally free on UK networks (unverified for ASDA specifics).

routes.acquisitionSummary: Free PAYG SIM from idmobile.co.uk (Currys/Carphone Warehouse brand, UK delivery). PAYG rates 3p/min, 2p/text, 1p/MB on Three network. No 2G coverage.

keep.action: Per clause 10.5 (cited by Ken's Tech Tips, Feb 2024): chargeable activity every 120 days or agreement may end (SMS warning after 90 days). Clause 12.4: top-up at least once every 365 days or unused credit expires. One 2p text every 120 days satisfies activity rule.

routes.chinaActivation: UK network activation expected; China-first activation unverified.
routes.payment: UK card; international card acceptance unverified.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Free PAYG SIM (Lite or Triple Credit plan) from tescomobile.com or Tesco stores. O2 network. Lite rates 8p/min, 4p/text, 10p/MB.

keep.action: Clause 5.4 (cited by Ken's Tech Tips): use phone at least once every 6 months or disconnected + number lost. One 4p text per 180 days satisfies. WARNING: official site reports Feb-Mar 2026 disconnection wave targeting long-inactive and 2G-only SIMs — keep the SIM in a modern phone with occasional chargeable activity.

routes.chinaActivation: UK network activation expected; China-first activation unverified. eSIM available per official site.
routes.payment: UK card / Tesco vouchers; international card acceptance unverified.
routes.tariffSummary: Lite: 8p/min, 4p/text, 10p/MB. Activity per 180d. Feb-Mar 2026 inactive-SIM disconnection wave.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Free SIM/eSIM from lycamobile.co.uk (UK delivery for physical). O2 network. International-call focused MVNO.

keep.action: Official FAQ (2026-09-27): number kept 120 days without use by default. OR dial *139*9999# and pay fixed £15 annual fee (deducted from balance) to keep number for 1 year with no usage. NOTE: Ken's Tech Tips (Feb 2024) listed this keep-number option at £5/yr — official FAQ now says £15/yr; trust official.

routes.chinaActivation: UK network activation expected; China-first activation unverified. eSIM available per official site.

routes.tariffSummary: £15/yr official keep-number plan (dial *139*9999#), or activity per 120d.

routes.acquisitionSummary: DEAD ROUTE: Talkmobile closed its PAYG service in 2017 (PAYG closure notice + MSE forum, May 2017). Talkmobile now only sells 30-day/12-month contract SIMs requiring UK credit check.
routes.kyc: Contract requires UK credit check + UK bank account.
routes.avoidReason: PAYG service closed 2017; only credit-checked contracts remain. Do not attempt for number retention.

routes.acquisitionSummary: SIM from smarty.co.uk (UK delivery; eSIM available). Three network MVNO. NO classic PAYG: subscription-only bundles from ~£5/mo (rolling 30-day).

keep.action: Subscription-only — number stays active while monthly plan renews; cancel plan and number is lost after disconnection. No idle PAYG mode. ~£60/yr minimum to retain.
